name: original_curvature_general_response_has_unique_einstein_form
text:
theorem original_curvature_general_response_has_unique_einstein_form
    (E : MetricFieldResponse) (natural : RegularLorentzResponseNatural E)
    (locality : RegularLorentzTwoJetLocal E) (original : OriginalCurvatureFirstResponse E)
    (symmetric : ∀ g p,C2LorentzMetricAt g p → ∀ i j,E g p i j=E g p j i)
    (general_closure : GeneralNormalMetricResponseClosure E)
    (active : FullLorentzEnvelopeResponseActive E) :
    ∃! ac : ℝ × ℝ,ac.1≠0 ∧ CoordinateEinsteinResponseForm E ac.1 ac.2 :=
  regular_general_envelope_unique_einstein_response E
    (original_curvature_response_derives_regular_core E natural locality original symmetric)
    general_closure active

name: eh_original_geometric_response_regular_natural
text:
theorem eh_original_geometric_response_regular_natural (κ Λ : ℝ) (hk : κ ≠ 0) :
    RegularLorentzResponseNatural (originalEHGeometricResponse κ Λ) := by
  intro F p B regularF derivative g domain
  obtain ⟨D,frame⟩ := domain.2.2
  exact eh_original_geometric_tensor_natural κ Λ hk g domain.1 F p domain.2.1
    (native_lorentz_frame_determinant_negative g (F p) D frame)
    (regularF.of_le (by norm_num)) B derivative

name: eh_original_geometric_response_twojet_local
text:
theorem eh_original_geometric_response_twojet_local (κ Λ : ℝ) (hk : κ ≠ 0) :
    RegularLorentzTwoJetLocal (originalEHGeometricResponse κ Λ) := by
  intro g h p dg dh equal
  obtain ⟨B,frameG⟩ := dg.2.2
  obtain ⟨D,frameH⟩ := dh.2.2
  have ng := native_lorentz_frame_determinant_negative g p B frameG
  have nh := native_lorentz_frame_determinant_negative h p D frameH
  have curv := c2_general_curvature_twojet_congr g h p dg.1 dh.1 dg.2.1 dh.2.1
    (ne_of_lt ng) (ne_of_lt nh) equal
  have ricci : coordinateRicci g p = coordinateRicci h p := by
    unfold coordinateRicci
    rw [equal.1,curv]
  rw [eh_original_geometric_tensor_identified κ Λ hk g p ng,
    eh_original_geometric_tensor_identified κ Λ hk h p nh]
  simp only [coordinateScalarCurvature,equal.1,ricci]

name: eh_original_geometric_response_symmetric
text:
theorem eh_original_geometric_response_symmetric (κ Λ : ℝ) (hk : κ ≠ 0)
    (g : MetricField) (p : CoordinatePoint) (domain : C2LorentzMetricAt g p) :
    ∀ a b, originalEHGeometricResponse κ Λ g p a b = originalEHGeometricResponse κ Λ g p b a := by
  obtain ⟨B,frame⟩ := domain.2.2
  rw [eh_original_geometric_tensor_identified κ Λ hk g p
    (native_lorentz_frame_determinant_negative g p B frame)]
  intro a b
  change -(1/κ) * (_ - _ * g p a b + Λ * g p a b) =
    -(1/κ) * (_ - _ * g p b a + Λ * g p b a)
  rw [coordinate_ricci_symmetric_on_regular_lorentz g p domain a b,domain.1 p a b]

end

name: eh_original_geometric_curvature_first_response
text:
theorem eh_original_geometric_curvature_first_response (κ Λ : ℝ) (hk : κ ≠ 0) :
    OriginalCurvatureFirstResponse (originalEHGeometricResponse κ Λ) := by
  have normal (g : MetricField) (hg : NormalizedSmoothMetricGerm g) :
      originalEHGeometricResponse κ Λ g 0 =
        -(1/κ) • actualEinsteinResponse g 0 + (-(1/κ)*Λ) • metric := by
    rw [eh_original_geometric_tensor_as_actual κ Λ hk g 0
      (eh_normalized_metric_determinant_negative g (original_smooth_normalized_is_c2 g hg)),hg.2.2.1]
  have flatGerm : NormalizedSmoothMetricGerm flatMetricField := by
    rw [← hessianMetricPolynomial_flat]
    exact hessianMetricPolynomial_normalized 0
  have flat : originalEHGeometricResponse κ Λ flatMetricField 0 = (-(1/κ)*Λ) • metric := by
    rw [normal flatMetricField flatGerm,actual_einstein_flat_baseline_zero,smul_zero,zero_add]
  constructor
  · intro g h k hg hh hkg curvature
    rw [normal k hkg,normal g hg,normal h hh,flat,
      actual_einstein_original_curvature_first_response.1 g h k hg hh hkg curvature,
      actual_einstein_flat_baseline_zero]
    module
  · intro r g k hg hkg curvature
    rw [normal k hkg,normal g hg,flat,
      actual_einstein_original_curvature_first_response.2 r g k hg hkg curvature,
      actual_einstein_flat_baseline_zero]
    module

name: eh_original_geometric_general_closure
text:
theorem eh_original_geometric_general_closure (κ Λ : ℝ) (hk : κ ≠ 0) :
    GeneralNormalMetricResponseClosure (originalEHGeometricResponse κ Λ) := by
  intro g germ
  have cg : ContinuousAt g 0 := continuousAt_pi.mpr (fun a => continuousAt_pi.mpr
    (fun b => (germ.2.1 a b).continuousAt))
  have near : ∀ᶠ p in 𝓝 0, (g p).det < 0 :=
    (((continuous_id : Continuous (fun M : Tensor2 => M)).matrix_det).continuousAt.comp cg).eventually
      (eventually_lt_nhds (eh_normalized_metric_determinant_negative g (c3_normalized_metric_c2 g germ)))
  have equal : originalEHGeometricResponse κ Λ g =ᶠ[𝓝 0]
      -(1/κ) • actualEinsteinResponse g + (-(1/κ)*Λ) • g := by
    filter_upwards [near] with p hp
    exact eh_original_geometric_tensor_as_actual κ Λ hk g p hp
  rw [coordinate_divergence_germ_congruence g _ _ equal]
  change coordinateDivergenceLinear g
    (-(1/κ) • (ricciTensorGerm g germ - (1/2:ℝ) • scalarMetricTensorGerm g germ) +
      (-(1/κ)*Λ) • metricTensorGerm g germ) = 0
  rw [map_add,map_smul,map_sub,map_smul,map_smul,c3_normal_divergence_ricci_germ,
    c3_normal_divergence_scalar_metric_germ,c3_normal_divergence_metric_germ]
  module

name: eh_original_geometric_full_envelope_active
text:
theorem eh_original_geometric_full_envelope_active (κ Λ : ℝ) (hk : κ ≠ 0) :
    FullLorentzEnvelopeResponseActive (originalEHGeometricResponse κ Λ) := by
  rintro ⟨c,pure⟩
  apply actual_einstein_full_envelope_active
  refine ⟨-κ*c-Λ,?_⟩
  intro g p B sg hg frame
  have h := pure g p B sg hg frame
  rw [eh_original_geometric_tensor_as_actual κ Λ hk g p
    (native_lorentz_frame_determinant_negative g p B frame)] at h
  ext i j
  have component := congrArg (fun M : Tensor2 => M i j) h
  change -(1/κ) * actualEinsteinResponse g p i j + (-(1/κ)*Λ) * g p i j = c * g p i j at component
  change actualEinsteinResponse g p i j = (-κ*c-Λ) * g p i j
  field_simp [hk] at component
  nlinarith

name: eh_original_geometric_response_unique_coefficients
text:
theorem eh_original_geometric_response_unique_coefficients (κ Λ : ℝ) (hk : κ ≠ 0) :
    ∃! ac : ℝ × ℝ, ac.1 ≠ 0 ∧ CoordinateEinsteinResponseForm (originalEHGeometricResponse κ Λ) ac.1 ac.2 :=
  regular_general_envelope_unique_einstein_response _
    (eh_original_geometric_response_regular_core κ Λ hk)
    (eh_original_geometric_general_closure κ Λ hk)

name: original_eh_actual_act_curve_admitted
text:
theorem original_eh_actual_act_curve_admitted (H : MetricSourceProbe Ω)
    (inside : H ∈ wickOriginalMetricNeighborhood Ω) (K : MetricSourceProbe Ω) :
    ∀ᶠ t : ℝ in 𝓝 0, H+t•K ∈ wickOriginalMetricNeighborhood Ω := by
  have continuousCurve : Continuous (fun t : ℝ => H+t•K) :=
    continuous_const.add (continuous_id.smul continuous_const)
  have atZero : H+(0:ℝ)•K ∈ wickOriginalMetricNeighborhood Ω := by simpa using inside
  exact continuousCurve.continuousAt ((wick_original_metric_neighborhood_open Ω).mem_nhds atZero)

name: original_eh_actual_act_hasDerivAt
text:
theorem original_eh_actual_act_hasDerivAt (κ Λ : ℝ) (coupling : κ ≠ 0)
    (H : MetricSourceProbe Ω) (inside : H ∈ wickOriginalMetricNeighborhood Ω)
    (K : MetricSourceProbe Ω) :
    HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => originalEHRelativeAction κ Λ wickNativeFlatMetric (H+t•K))
      ((originalEHFirstVariation κ Λ coupling (originalEHActMetric H)
        (original_eh_act_metric_symmetric H) (original_eh_act_metric_smooth H)
        (fun p _ => original_eh_act_metric_negative H inside p)) K) 0 := by
  have variation := eh_original_first_variation_hasDerivAt κ Λ coupling (originalEHActMetric H)
    (original_eh_act_metric_symmetric H) (original_eh_act_metric_smooth H)
    (fun p (_ : p ∈ Ω) => original_eh_act_metric_negative H inside p) K
  apply (variation.add_const (originalEHRelativeAction κ Λ wickNativeFlatMetric H)).congr_of_eventuallyEq
  filter_upwards [original_eh_actual_act_curve_admitted H inside K] with t ht
  rw [original_eh_action_cocycle κ Λ coupling H (t•K) inside ht]
  ring

name: restricted_original_response_comparison_exact
text:
theorem restricted_original_response_comparison_exact (h k : RestrictedRawHistory a Ω) :
    RestrictedRawProgramSame a s Ω h k ↔
      restrictedRawHistoryReceive a s Ω h = restrictedRawHistoryReceive a s Ω k := by
  have left := restricted_raw_history_run_matches a s Ω h
  have right := restricted_raw_history_run_matches a s Ω k
  unfold RestrictedRawProgramSame
  rw [restricted_raw_state_comparison_exact]
  rw [left.1, right.1, left.2.1, right.2.1, left.2.2, right.2.2]
  exact (prepared_history_receive_eq_iff a s Ω _ _).symm

name: restricted_original_response_receive_bijective
text:
theorem restricted_original_response_receive_bijective :
    Function.Bijective (restrictedOriginalResponseReceive a s Ω) := by
  constructor
  · intro x y same
    induction x using Quotient.inductionOn with
    | _ h =>
      induction y using Quotient.inductionOn with
      | _ k =>
        exact Quotient.sound ((restricted_original_response_comparison_exact a s Ω h k).mpr same)
  · intro q
    obtain ⟨h, same⟩ := restricted_raw_history_receive_surjective a s Ω q
    exact ⟨Quotient.mk _ h, same⟩

name: restricted_original_response_continuation_square
text:
theorem restricted_original_response_continuation_square (ops : List (PreparedHistoryOperation a Ω))
    (q : RestrictedOriginalResponse a s Ω) :
    restrictedOriginalResponseReceive a s Ω (restrictedOriginalResponseContinue a s Ω ops q) =
      preparedHistoryContinue a s Ω ops (restrictedOriginalResponseReceive a s Ω q) := by
  induction q using Quotient.inductionOn with
  | _ h => rfl

end
